# GitHub Reusable Workflow: Check meetup referentials and issue form

<!-- header:end -->
<!-- badges:start -->

<!-- overview:start -->

## Overview

Reusable workflow that checks referential catalogs and the generated meetup
issue-form projection for consumer pull requests.

### Permissions

- **`contents`**: `read`

<!-- overview:end -->
<!-- usage:start -->

## Usage

```yaml
name: Check meetup referentials and issue form
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
permissions: {}
jobs:
  check-meetup-referentials-and-issue-form:
    uses: cloud-native-aixmarseille/meetup-issue-linter-action/.github/workflows/check-meetup-referentials-and-issue-form.yml@88fd8c3495bfbf7061bbd67d1324b0b4e4bc14d3 # main
    permissions:
      contents: read
```

<!-- usage:end -->

## Outputs

| **Output**                     | **Description**                                                                              |
| ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`is-valid`**                 | Whether the private referential catalogs passed validation.                                  |
| **`host-count`**               | Number of valid host entries detected during referential validation.                         |
| **`speaker-count`**            | Number of valid speaker entries detected during referential validation.                      |
| **`referential-diagnostics`**  | Redacted JSON diagnostics produced during referential validation.                            |
| **`issue-form-changed`**       | Whether the checked-out issue form differs from the desired public projection.               |
| **`issue-form-changed-files`** | JSON array of repository-relative files that would change during issue-form synchronization. |
| **`issue-form-diagnostics`**   | Redacted JSON diagnostics produced by the issue-form projection check.                       |

<!-- outputs:end -->
